A '''hyperlane''' ran through the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], beginning at [[Manda/Legends|Manda]] and ending at [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], where it joined with the start of the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]].<ref name="TEA" />
